versions.content: If the received signal/ signal group has no update-bit (ComUpdateBitPosition) configured and the destination signal/ signal group has an update-bit configured, the AUTOSAR COM module shall set the update-bit of the destination signal when a new signal/ signal group was received and clear it after sending of the destination signal/ signal group.
